# Map

```{r}
coord <- data.frame(site = c("Pristine", "Dredged"),
                    latitude = c("48 17.234", "48 19.156"),
                    longitude = c("-4 21.179", "-4 23.051")) %>% 
  mutate(latitude = conv_unit(.$latitude, from = "deg_dec_min", to = "dec_deg"),
         longitude = conv_unit(.$longitude, from = "deg_dec_min", to = "dec_deg")) %>% 
  st_as_sf(coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs = 4326) %>%
  st_transform(coords, crs = 3857)

#polygone bretagne
eu_sig <- st_read("data/FRA_adm_shp/FRA_adm0.shp")

brit2 <- st_crop(eu_sig, y = c(xmin = -4.6, xmax = -4.2, ymin = 48.249, ymax =48.4))
brit2<- st_transform(brit2, crs = 3857)
#donnee brute ofb
ofb_data <- read_sf("data/export_maj-4/maj.shp")
ofb_data <- st_make_valid(ofb_data)
brit_buffer <- st_buffer(brit2, 10000)

subset.int<-st_intersects(ofb_data, brit_buffer)
subset.int.log <- lengths(subset.int) > 0
brittany_only <- filter(ofb_data, subset.int.log)

#buffer de 200m autour de chaque polygone
buff_200 <- sf::st_buffer(brittany_only, 200)
buff200_units <- buff_200 %>% 
  st_union %>% 
  st_cast('POLYGON') %>% 
  st_sf %>% 
  mutate(
    unit = row_number()
  )
buff_units <- brittany_only %>% 
  st_join(buff200_units, join = st_intersects)

grouped_buff <- buff_units %>% 
  group_by(unit, zone) %>% 
  summarise() %>% 
  #buffer de 2000m autour de chaque point d'échantillonage REBENT pour definir la taille de chaque site.
  st_join(st_buffer(coord, 1000), join = st_intersects) %>% 
  group_by(site) %>% 
  summarise() %>% 
  na.omit()

# Retrieve a map layer for France
france_data <- map_data("france")
names(france_data) <- c("X","Y","PID","POS","region","subregion")

# Zoom on Brittany
xlim <- c(-7.5,-1.8)
ylim <- c(46,49)
francemap <- PBSmapping::clipPolys(france_data, xlim=xlim,ylim=ylim, keepExtra=TRUE)

# Color Brittany (Bretagne)
fill_bret <- rep("gray75",nrow(france_data))
fill_bret[france_data$region=="Finistere"] <- "gray35"



france_map <- ggplot() + coord_map()
france_map <- france_map + scale_x_continuous(expand=c(0,0))
france_map <- france_map + theme(axis.ticks=element_blank(), axis.title=element_blank(), axis.text=element_blank())
france_map <- france_map + geom_polygon(data=france_data, mapping=aes(x=X, y=Y,group=PID), fill=fill_bret,col=fill_bret) 
france_map <- france_map + theme_void() 



(
  p_map <- ggplot() +
    geom_sf(
      data = grouped_buff %>% st_cast("MULTIPOLYGON"),
      aes(fill = site),
      col = "transparent",
      alpha = .3
    ) +
    geom_sf(
      data = brit2 %>% st_cast("MULTIPOLYGON"),
      fill = "gray90",
      col = "transparent"
    ) +
    geom_rect(aes(xmin = -511500, xmax = -501500, ymin = 6162000, ymax = 6172000), fill = alpha("white", .25), col = "black")+
    geom_sf(data = coord, aes(col = site), size = 1) +
    annotation_custom(grob = ggplotGrob(france_map), xmin = -511000, xmax = -502000, ymin = 6160192, ymax = 6173689) +
    coord_sf(
      expand = FALSE,
      label_axes = list(top = "E", left = "N")) +
        theme(
          panel.background = element_blank(),
          panel.grid = element_blank(),
          text = element_text(size = 11),
          axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90),
          legend.position = c(.9, .1),
          legend.background = element_blank()
        ) +
        scale_x_continuous(name = "", breaks = c(-4.6, -4.4, -4.2)) +
        scale_y_continuous(name = "", breaks =  c(48.4, 48.3, 48.2)) +
        # scale_fill_manual(values = pal)+
        # scale_colour_manual(values = pal)+
        ggspatial::annotation_scale(aes(width_hint = .2, style = "ticks")) +
    ggspatial::annotation_north_arrow(height = unit(1, "cm"), width = unit(1, "cm"),
                         which_north = "true", location = "bl", 
                         pad_x = unit(0.4, "in"), pad_y = unit(0.5, "in")) +
        scale_colour_manual(values = c("#D41159", "#1A85FF")) +
        scale_fill_manual(values = c("#D41159", "#1A85FF"))
    )
```

## Species rarefaction curves

```{r}
mpbc_raw <- read.csv("data/mpb_counts.csv", header = TRUE, row.names = 1 ) 

mpbc_homo <- mpbc_raw %>% 
  rownames_to_column("sp") %>% 
  mutate(sp = case_match(sp,
    "Bacillaria paradoxa" ~ "Bacillaria paxillifera",
    "Licmophora cf. flavellata" ~ "Licmophora cf. flabellata",
    "Campilodiscus sp." ~ "Campylodiscus sp.",
    "Achnantes sp." ~ "Achnanthes sp.",
    "Nitzschioides" ~ "Bacillariaceae",
    "Licmophora cf. flavellata" ~ "Licmophora cf. flabellata",
    "Nitzschia sp." ~ "Nitzschia sp.1",
    "Agregats Nitzschia sp." ~ "Nitzschia sp.2",
    "Entomoneis sp." ~ "Entomoneis sp.1",
    "Entomoneis sp. (petite)" ~ "Entomoneis sp.2",
    "Amphora sp." ~ "Amphora sp.1",
    "Amphora sp. (petite)" ~ "Amphora sp.2",
    "Synedra sp. (courbe)" ~"Synedra sp.",
    "Melosira moniliformis (chaine)" ~ "Melosira moniliformis",
    "Paralia sulcata (chaînes)" ~ "Paralia sulcata",
    "Diatomee pennee 100 µm" ~ "Bacillariophyceae",
     "Naviculoides" ~ "Naviculaceae",
    "Diatomees en gelee" ~ "Bacillariophyta",
    "Rhoicosphaenia sp." ~ "Rhoicosphenia sp.",
    "Toxarium hennedianum" ~ "Toxarium hennedyanum",
    .default = sp)
    )  %>% 
  filter(!sp %in% c("Bacillariophyta", "Nitzschia sp.2")) %>% 
  arrange(sp)
  

mpbc <- as.data.frame(t(mpbc_homo %>% column_to_rownames("sp")))
mpbc[is.na(mpbc)] <-0
rowSums(mpbc)
S <- data.frame(S = specnumber(mpbc), row.names = row.names(mpbc)) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("code") %>% 
  mutate(site = str_sub(code,1, 1),
         site = as.factor(case_when(site== "L" ~ "Pristine",
                           site == "R" ~ "Dredged")),
         month = as.numeric(str_sub(code, 5,6)),
         season = as.factor(case_when(month < 3 ~ "Winter",
                            month >= 3 & month < 7 ~ "Spring",
         month > 6 & month < 9 ~ "Summer",
         month >= 9 ~ "Autumn")),
         month = as.factor(month),
         date = as.Date(str_sub(code,2, -1), "%d_%m_%y"),
         date2 = as.factor(date))

mod1 <- lm(formula = S ~ site + date2, data = S)
jtools::summ(mod1)
shapiro.test(S$S)
shapiro.test(resid(mod1))
car::ncvTest(mod1)
anova(mod1)


mpbc_site <- mpbc %>% 
  tibble::rownames_to_column("code") %>% 
  mutate(site = str_sub(code,1, 1)) %>% 
  group_by(site) %>% 
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric), sum)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%  
  column_to_rownames("site")

out_site <- iNEXT(x = t(mpbc_site), datatype = "abundance")

z <- fortify(out_site, type=1)%>% 
  mutate(site = str_sub(Assemblage,1, 1),
         site = case_when(site == "L" ~ "Pristine",
                           site == "R" ~ "Dredged"))

data.sub <- z[which(z$Method=="Observed"),]

z <- z %>% 
  mutate(Method = case_when(Method == "Observed" ~ "Rarefaction",
                             .default = Method))

ggplot(z, aes(x=x, y=y, colour=site)) + 
    geom_point(data = data.sub, aes(shape=site), size=3.5) +
  geom_line(aes(linetype=Method), lwd=1.25) +
  geom_ribbon(aes_string(ymin="y.lwr", ymax="y.upr", fill="site", colour="NULL"), alpha=0.2)+
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c(2,1))+
  guides(linetype=guide_legend(title=NULL),
           colour=guide_legend(title=NULL), 
           fill=guide_legend(title=NULL)) +
  labs(x ="Number of individuals", y = "Species richness")+
  theme_light()+
  theme_light()+
  theme(legend.position = c(.8, .15),
        panel.background = element_blank(),
        legend.title=element_blank(),
        text=element_text(size=11),
        legend.key.width = unit(1.2,"cm"),
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        aspect.ratio = .5
        )+
  scale_colour_manual(values = rev(c("#1A85FF", "#D41159")))+
  scale_fill_manual(values = rev(c("#1A85FF", "#D41159")))+
  guides(linetype = "legend", colour = "none", shape = "none", fill = "none")



p_inext <- ggiNEXT(out_site, type = 1)+
  labs(x ="Number of individuals", y = "Species richness")+
  theme_light()+
  theme(legend.position = c(.8, .15),
        panel.background = element_blank(),
        legend.title=element_blank(),
        text=element_text(size=11),
        legend.key.width = unit(1.2,"cm"),
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        aspect.ratio = .5
        )+
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("#1A85FF", "#D41159"))+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#1A85FF", "#D41159"))+
  guides(linetype = "legend", colour = "none", shape = "none", fill = "none")

(fig1 <- p_map / p_inext)
```

## Global trait space

```{r}
traits <- read.csv("data/traits.csv", header = TRUE) %>% 
  filter(!sp %in% c("Bacillariophyta", "Nitzchia sp.2")) %>% 
  select(-ellipsoid) %>% 
  column_to_rownames("sp")


gdis <- gawdis::gawdis(
  traits,
  w.type = "equal",
  groups = c(
    1, #bv
    rep(2, 7), #shape
    rep(3, 5), #living habit
    rep(4, 6), #sociability
    rep(5, 3), #raphe
    rep(6, 5) #attachment
  ),
  fuzzy = c(2:28)
)

qfsp <- mFD::quality.fspaces(
  sp_dist = gdis,
  fdendro = "average",
  maxdim_pcoa = 10,
  deviation_weighting = c("absolute"),
  fdist_scaling = FALSE
)

mFD::quality.fspaces.plot(
  fspaces_quality = qfsp,
  fspaces_plot = rownames(qfsp$quality_fspaces)[4:7],
  quality_metric = "mad"
)

ppcoa <- vegan::wcmdscale(sqrt(gdis), k = 5, eig = TRUE)

var_axes <- round(ppcoa$eig[ppcoa$eig >0]/sum(ppcoa$eig[ppcoa$eig > 0])*100,2)
pcoaxes <- scores(ppcoa) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("sp")

pcoarr <- as.data.frame(scores(envfit(ppcoa, traits, na.rm = TRUE), "vectors")) %>%
  mutate(r2 = envfit(ppcoa, traits, na.rm = TRUE)[["vectors"]]$r,
         p = envfit(ppcoa, traits, na.rm = TRUE)[["vectors"]]$pvals,
         sig = ifelse(p < .05, "significant", "nonsignificant"))

(p_ts <- ggplot() +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0,
               linetype = 2) + 
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0,
               linetype = 2) + 
    geom_segment(data = pcoarr ,
                 aes(x = 0,
                     y = 0,
                     xend = Dim1,
                     yend = Dim2,
                     linewidth = sqrt(r2)),
                 arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.30, "cm")))+
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(data = pcoarr,
                             aes(x = Dim1,
                                 y = Dim2,
                                 label = rownames(pcoarr ),
                                 size = sqrt(r2)),
                             inherit.aes = FALSE)+
    ggpubr::stat_chull(
      data = pcoaxes,
      mapping = aes(
        x = Dim1,
        y = Dim2,
      ),
      colour = "gray45",
      fill = "gray45",
      geom = "polygon",
      alpha = .1,
      linewidth = .6
    )+
    geom_point(
      data = pcoaxes,
      mapping = aes(
        x = Dim1,
        y = Dim2,
        colour = colour
      ),
      colour = "gray45",
      alpha = .8
    ) +
    scale_linewidth_continuous(range = c(0.25,1))+
    scale_size_continuous(range = c(2.8,4.2))+
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-.95,.95), expand = FALSE)+
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-.95,.95), expand = FALSE)+
    theme_light()+
    labs(x = paste("Dim 1 :", var_axes[1], "%", sep = " "),
         y = paste("Dim 2 :", var_axes[2], "%", sep = " "))+
    theme(text = element_text(size = 11),
          aspect.ratio = 1,
          panel.background = element_blank(),
          panel.grid = element_blank(),
          legend.position = "none"
    ))

# ggsave(filename = "fig_ts.svg", plot = p_ts, device = svglite::svglite, width = 190, height = 190, units = "mm", dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
all_fuzzy <- traits %>%

         bv_5_10 = as.integer(if_else(bv < 10000 & bv >= 5000, 4, 0)),
         bv_10_20 = as.integer(if_else(bv < 20000 & bv >= 10000, 4, 0)),
```

## Site trait space

```{r}
#| fig-height: 6.5
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| echo: false

library(reshape)

surf <- (pi*(2.7^2))*10^-4 #m2
vtot <- 0.1 #Litres
vsub <- 0.003 #Litres
mpbc_m2 <- mpbc %>% 
  mutate(across(.cols = everything(), .fns = ~ .x * (vtot/vsub) * 1/surf))

mpbc_site <- mpbc_m2 %>%
  rownames_to_column("code") %>%
  mutate(site = str_sub(code,1, 1),
         site = case_when(site== "L" ~ "Lomergat",
                           site == "R" ~ "Rozegat")) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = `Achnanthes sp.`:`Tryblionella sp.`,
                      names_to = "sp",
                      values_to ="n") %>% 
  filter(!sp %in% c("Bacillariophyta", "Nitzschia sp.2"))

poly <- cast(mpbc_site, formula = site~sp, value = 'n', fun.aggregate = sum)
rownames(poly) <- NULL
poly <- poly %>%
  column_to_rownames("site") %>%
  # decostand(., method = "hellinger") %>% 
  rownames_to_column("site")
poly <- melt(poly, variable_name = "sp") %>%
  mutate(site = as.factor(site)) %>%
  group_by(site,sp) %>%
  summarise(n = sum(value)) %>%
  ungroup() 
df <- data.frame()
for (i in levels(poly$site)) {
    df_i <- poly %>%
      filter(site == i) %>%
      filter(n > 0) %>%
      select(sp, site, n) %>% 
      left_join(pcoaxes)
  df <- rbind(df, df_i)
  df
}

df <- df %>%
  mutate(AZ1 = n*Dim1,
         AZ2 = n*Dim2) %>% 
  group_by(site) %>%
  mutate(C1 = sum(AZ1)/sum(n),
         C2 = sum(AZ2)/sum(n)) %>% 
  ungroup()
  


(p1 <- ggplot() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0,
             linetype = 2) + 
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0,
             linetype = 2) + 
  ggpubr::stat_chull(
    data = df,
    mapping = aes(
      x = Dim1,
      y = Dim2,
      fill = site,
      colour = site,
    ),
    geom = "polygon",
    alpha = .1,
    linetype = 2,
    linewidth = .4
  ) +
   # geom_segment(
   #  data = df,
   #  aes(
   #    x = C1,
   #    y = C2,
   #    xend = Dim1,
   #    yend = Dim2,
   #    colour = site
   #    ),
   #  linetype = 2,
   #  linewidth = .2,
   #  alpha = .5) +
  geom_point(
    data = df %>% arrange(desc(n)),
    mapping = aes(
      x = Dim1,
      y = Dim2,
      colour = site,
      # shape = year,
      size = n
    ),
    alpha = 1
  ) +
  #   geom_point(
```

```{r}
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0,
```

## Assemblage x trait matrix

```{r}
# Recode the matrix to give the same weights to all traits 
#----------------------------------------------------------

# Create the function to convert the fuzzy coded matrix (going from 0 to 4 for each modality) to a relative coding in which all modality of a given trait sum to 1 for each species
transfo_traits <- function(x) {
  if (is.na(sum(x))) { # If we have NA's, gives back NA's
    rep(NA, length(x))
  } else if (sum(x) == 0) { #  If we have only 0's, gives back only 0's
    numeric(length(x))
  } else { # Else, we get the modality's score and divide it by the sum of the scores of the species for all modalities of this trait
    x / sum(x)
  }
}
all_fuzzy <- traits %>% 
  mutate(bv_5 = as.integer(if_else(bv < 5000, 4, 0)),
         bv_5_10 = as.integer(if_else(bv < 10000 & bv >= 5000, 4, 0)),
         bv_10_20 = as.integer(if_else(bv < 20000 & bv >= 10000, 4, 0)),
         bv_20_40 = as.integer(if_else(bv < 40000 & bv >= 20000, 4, 0)),
         bv_40 = as.integer(if_else(bv >= 40000, 4, 0))) %>%
  select(-bv)
trait_list <- data.frame(modality= colnames(all_fuzzy)) %>% 
  mutate(trait = c(
    rep("shape", 7), #shape
    rep("living habit", 5), #living habit
    rep("sociability", 6), #sociability
    rep("raphe", 3), #raphe
    rep("attachment", 5),
    rep("biovolume", 5)#attachment
  ))
  

# Prepare the trait list to apply the function
trait_list <- trait_list %>%
  # Reorder the list according to the order of the modalities in trait_fuz
  slice(match(colnames(all_fuzzy), trait_list$modality)) %>%
  # Reorder the trait factor levels
  mutate(trait = factor(trait, levels=unique(trait))) %>%
  droplevels()

# Compute the number of traits
n_trait <- nlevels(trait_list$trait)

# Define the start and end point of each trait
n_mod <- trait_list %>%
  # For that we compute the number of modalities for each trait
  group_by(trait) %>%
  summarise(n=n()) %>%
  pull(n) %>%
  # And we do the cumulative sum
  cumsum(.) %>%
  c(0,.)

# Apply the function
trait_prop <- all_fuzzy 
fuzzy_only <- all_fuzzy 
trait_prop[,] <- NA

for(i in 1:n_trait){
  # Select all the modalities of the trait i
  tmp <- fuzzy_only[,seq(from=n_mod[i]+1, to=n_mod[i+1], by=1)]
  # Apply the function to this trait
  tmp <- t(apply(tmp, 1, transfo_traits))
  tmp <- as.data.frame(tmp)
  # Save
  trait_prop[,seq(from=n_mod[i]+1, to=n_mod[i+1], by=1)] <- tmp
}





summary(trait_prop) %>%
  kableExtra::kable("html") %>%
  kableExtra::kable_styling(full_width = F, position="left") %>%
  kableExtra::column_spec(column = n_mod+1, border_right = TRUE, include_thead = TRUE)



# com_trait <- as.matrix(mpbc_m2) %*% as.matrix(trait_prop)


# mpbc_m2 <- mpbc_m2 %>% 
#   select(-Bacillariophyta, -`Nitzschia sp.2`)

# Compute CWM (we need to tell functcomp that trait_prop should considered as numerical) 
CWM_tot <- FD::functcomp(x=trait_prop,
                         a=as.matrix(mpbc_m2),
                         bin.num=c("cylinder",
                                   "cymbelloid",
                                   "gomphonemoid",
                                   "prism.on.triangular.base",
                                   "zigzag",
                                   "araphid",
                                   "biraphid",
                                   "monoraphid",
                                   "tubes",
                                   "bv_5",
                                   "bv_5_10",
                                   "bv_10_20",
                                   "bv_20_40",
                                   "bv_40")) %>%
  # Ensure that all variables are considered as numerical
  mutate(across(everything(), ~as.numeric(as.character(.x))))

# Compute the abundance matrix
com_trait_estim_CWM <- rowSums(mpbc_m2,na.rm = TRUE) * CWM_tot
rownames(com_trait_estim_CWM) <- rownames(mpbc_m2)

# Check that the sum of abundances for each trait is equal to the total abundance of the sites

trait_list <- data.frame(modality= colnames(all_fuzzy)) %>% 
  mutate(trait = c(
    rep("shape", 7), #shape
    rep("living habit", 5), #living habit
    rep("sociability", 6), #sociability
    rep("raphe", 3), #raphe
    rep("attachment", 5),
    rep("biovolume", 5)#attachment
  ))

check_CWM <- com_trait_estim_CWM %>%
  rownames_to_column("id") %>%
  tidyr::gather(modality, value,-id) %>%
  left_join(., trait_list) %>%
  group_by(id,trait) %>%
  summarise(value = sum(value,na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  left_join(., data.frame(id=rownames(mpbc_m2),tot=rowSums(mpbc_m2))) %>%
  mutate(match_init = near(value,tot, tol = 1e-6))

all(check_CWM$match_init)
```

## CWM traj

```{r}
CWM_pcoa <- pcoa(dist.ldc(CWM_tot, "hellinger"), correction="none", rn=NULL)
# Calculate weighted average scores using the species data and PCoA result
weighted_scores <- wascores(CWM_pcoa$vectors, CWM_tot)

# Extract the scores for PCoA1 and PCoA2 dimensions
weighted_scores_pcoa <- data.frame(Dim1 =  weighted_scores[,1],
                                   Dim2 =  weighted_scores[,2])

# Select the top contributing species (e.g., top 10)
(top_species <- rownames(weighted_scores_pcoa)[order(weighted_scores_pcoa$Dim1, decreasing = TRUE)][1:9])

meta <- as.data.frame(CWM_tot) %>% 
  tibble::rownames_to_column("code") %>% 
  mutate(site = str_sub(code,1, 1),
         site = as.factor(ifelse(site == "R","Dredged", "Pristine")),
         month = as.numeric(str_sub(code, 5,6)),
         season = case_when(month < 3 ~ "Winter",
                            month >= 3 & month < 7 ~ "Spring",
         month > 6 & month < 9 ~ "Summer",
         month >= 9 ~ "Autumn"),
         date = as.Date(str_sub(code,2, -1), "%d_%m_%y")) %>% 
  select(site, month, season,code, date)

traj <- defineTrajectories(dist.ldc(CWM_tot, "hellinger"), sites =meta$site, times = meta$month)
trajobj <- trajectoryPCoA(traj,  traj.colors = c("red", "blue"), lwd = 2, 
                      survey.labels = F)
legend("bottomleft", col = c("red", "blue"), legend=levels(meta$site), bty="n", lty=1, lwd = 2)


trajdf <- trajobj$points %>% as.data.frame()%>%
  bind_cols(meta)
```

# Carbon estimation

```{r}
bv <- traits %>% 
  rownames_to_column("sp") %>% 
  mutate(c_pg = 10^(.76*log10(bv)-.352)) %>% 
  arrange(sp) %>% 
  select(sp, bv, c_pg)
mpbc_homo[is.na(mpbc_homo)] <- 0

surf <- (pi*(2.7^2))*10^-4 #m2
vtot <- 0.1 #Litres
vsub <- 0.003 #Litres
mpbb_m2 <- mpbc_homo %>% 
  mutate(across(.cols = -sp, .fns = ~ .x * (vtot/vsub) * 1/surf))

mpbb <- mpbb_m2 %>% 
  left_join(bv) %>% 
  mutate(across(.cols = R18_02_2021:L27_10_2021, .fns = ~ .x * c_pg * 1e-6)) %>% 
  select(-c_pg, -bv) %>% 
  column_to_rownames("sp") %>% 
  na.omit() %>% 
  t() %>% 
  as.data.frame()

btot <- data.frame(code = rownames(mpbb), biomass =rowSums(mpbb), dens = rowSums(mpbc_m2)) %>% 
  mutate(site = str_sub(code,1, 1),
         site = as.factor(case_when(site== "L" ~ "Pristine",
                           site == "R" ~ "Dredged")),
         month = as.numeric(str_sub(code, 5,6)),
         season = as.factor(case_when(month < 3 ~ "Winter",
                            month >= 3 & month < 7 ~ "Spring",
         month > 6 & month < 9 ~ "Summer",
         month >= 9 ~ "Autumn")),
         month = as.factor(month),
         date = as.Date(str_sub(code,2, -1), "%d_%m_%y"),
         date2 = as.factor(date)) %>%
  left_join(pfdsite)

(pb <- ggplot(btot)+
  geom_line(aes(x = date,
                y = biomass*1e-3,
                colour = site,
                group = site),
            linewidth = 1)+
  scale_y_log10()+
  scale_x_date(date_labels = "%b",
               breaks = btot$date)+
  theme_light()+
  theme(text = element_text(size = 11),
          # aspect.ratio = .5,
          panel.background = element_blank(),
          panel.grid = element_blank(),
          legend.position = "none"
    )+
      scale_colour_manual(values = c("#D41159", "#1A85FF"))+
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("#D41159", "#1A85FF"))+
  labs(y = expression(paste("Biomass (mg C ", m^-2, ")")),
         x = "Date")+
  coord_cartesian(expand = c(left =FALSE,
                             right = FALSE)))

shapiro.test(btot$biomass[pfdsite$site=="Pristine"])
shapiro.test(btot$biomass[pfdsite$site=="Dredged"])
```
